questions: Should names be split on whitespace or punctuation? For example, is 'Mr. X' one name or two ('Mr.' and 'X')?
What constitutes a 'bracket'? Only square brackets '[...]', or also parentheses '(...)' or curly braces '{...}'?
If a name appears both inside and outside brackets (e.g., 'John [John]'), should both occurrences be counted, or only the one outside brackets?
Should the bar chart axes be returned even if empty (None) or should an empty plot object be created?
Are names case-sensitive? Is 'John' different from 'john'?
How should nested brackets be handled? For example, 'John [Address [Apt]]' - is the entire '[Address [Apt]]' excluded?
Should leading/trailing whitespace be trimmed from names before counting, or preserved as part of the name?
What if the text contains no brackets at all? Should the entire text be considered a single name?
